question: Which of the following is NOT a 'grassland'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Fen.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Fens**, also known as the **Fenlands**, in eastern England are a naturally marshy region supporting a rich ecology and numerous species.
 
• Fen is the local term for an individual area of marshland or former marshland.
 
• It also designates the type of marsh typical of the area, which has neutral or alkaline water and relatively large quantities of dissolved minerals, but few other plant nutrients.
 
• **Most of the Fens lie within a few metres of sea level. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** A**** savanna or savannah** is a mixed woodland-grassland ecosystem characterised by the trees being sufficiently widely spaced so that the canopy does not close. 
 
• **Prairies **are ecosystems considered part of the temperate grasslands, savannas, and shrublands biome by ecologists.
 
• **Steppe **is an ecoregion characterized by grassland plains without trees apart from those near rivers and lakes.
